summary: Stale command menu hid Cufant's queued KO before Rock Smash acknowledgement
symptom: After a verified Cufant Rock Smash exchange, the adapter repeatedly reported command_menu at 9/56 HP. The next choose_move call returned ack command_menu with Rock Smash PP unchanged, while RAM later showed Cufant fainted and Eelektrik unchanged at 37/54.
root_cause: The command-menu signature was accepted while a queued Eelektrik action/faint transition still owned the battle field; move PP and battler identity were not treated as the acknowledgement boundary.
fix: Reject any move result whose PP does not decrement. Before every important action, require stable command subject, active battler HP/species, no active field tasks, and drained battle text across repeated reads; if an action returns command_menu without PP change, drain and classify the result before sending further input.
recovery: Load only the newest verified forward pre-battle checkpoint and rerun; this is permitted under the accidental/tooling-corruption recovery rule. Do not use a post-loss checkpoint to retry the deliberate strategy.
